title: Scripture and Worship
definition: Scripture and Worship means God’s Word reveals who God is and teaches His people how to respond to Him with reverence, love, praise, and obedience.
summary: Scripture and Worship means God’s Word reveals who God is and teaches His people how to respond to Him with reverence, love, praise, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus is worthy of worship, and Scripture reveals His glory, His saving work, and the worship due to God through Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Worship is not only music or emotion. Worship is the whole-life response of reverence, love, trust, praise, surrender, and obedience to God. Scripture tells us who God is so our worship is rooted in truth.

God’s Word shapes worship by revealing His holiness, mercy, power, justice, grace, and faithfulness. Without Scripture, worship can become centered on preference, performance, or feeling rather than God Himself.

Christ stands at the center of Christian worship. He is the Lamb who was slain, the risen Lord, the mediator who brings us near, and the King who deserves all glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people confuse worship with atmosphere, style, or personal taste. Scripture and worship corrects that by bringing the focus back to God’s revealed glory and the Gospel of Christ.

This doctrine also comforts believers who cannot express worship the way others can. Worship is not measured by platform, ability, or volume, but by a heart surrendered to God through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture lead your worship. Praise God for who He reveals Himself to be, respond to Christ with gratitude and obedience, and offer your body, mind, words, and choices as worship by the power of the Holy Spirit.
